title: NASA Human System Risks: Sensorimotor Risk
summary: NASA identifies altered-gravity effects on manual and fine motor control as part of sensorimotor risk, especially around gravity transitions.
application: Motivates exploring a repeatable hand-movement task. BLINDSPOT measures observed tapping and separately reports whether tracking supports a personal comparison.
limitations: This resource does not validate webcam tapping, establish quality cutoffs, or supply clinical thresholds. No astronaut data is used in this prototype. No NASA endorsement is implied.
